exq.q: Why are you so quiet? Are you upset about something?
exq.a: A little. I had an argument with my sister this morning.
w: I'm going to the market tomorrow.
A little. I'll have an argument with my sister tomorrow.
I got the part in the school play!
exq.why: Hỏi vì sao buồn → kể chuyện cãi nhau với chị.

exq.q: I love your new haircut! It really suits you.
exq.a: Aw, thanks! I was a bit worried it was too short.
w: Thanks! I'm going to cut it short tomorrow.
Thanks! My sister has a new hat.
Thanks! I was a bit worried about the exam.
exq.why: Được khen → cảm ơn + nói điều mình lo.

exq.q: Can you believe it? We won the match!
exq.a: I know! I'm still shaking with excitement!
w: Sorry to hear that. Better luck next time!
The match starts at three o'clock.
I know! We lost the match yesterday.
exq.why: Báo tin thắng → chia vui: I know!

exq.q: Is it okay if I disagree with you on this?
exq.a: Of course. We don't have to agree on everything.
w: Of course. You must agree with me on everything.
Yes, the meeting is at ten o'clock.
Sure, I'm going to the library tomorrow.
exq.why: Of course = tất nhiên được, không cần đồng ý mọi chuyện.

exq.q: Are you looking forward to the school trip?
exq.a: Definitely! But I'm kind of scared of the zip line.
w: Definitely! I went on the school trip yesterday.
The school is next to the park.
exq.why: looking forward to = mong chờ → Definitely!
